supported_partial_ordering.claim: Manager reservation precedes actual launch, role acknowledgement and activation; only then sole Task writer ownership applies.
New ordinary Curator intake validates selection before reservation source/context inclusion, actual receipt, reads and confirmed activation.
Session-start gathers observations and retains pending signals; current-owner evaluation and selected dispatch remain separate.
Delivery consumption follows a completed outcome and attributable canonical owner receipt; dispatch alone does not consume it.
Log access starts with a summary, then bounded query/excerpts when needed; this ordering is local to log access.
